about: One day of a busy series made free here, then the whole series made free, then busy again, then a poll. Google writes each of the master's markings into every exception (live probe of 2026-11-16), so after the second the day is busy at Google; the rows here must say what Google holds and the day must hold its series' marking or own its own (x-agree, x-own, x-write-asked).
